messages.text: Hi! I ordered two candles last week (order 1041) and haven't got them yet. Any idea where they are?

Hi Maya, thanks for checking in. Order #1041 shipped on March 3 with USPS (tracking 9400100000000000001041) and was scanned in Denver yesterday, so it's on its way to Austin. USPS Ground usually takes 3-6 business days, so it should arrive in the next day or two.
Hello, I placed order #1042 on Thursday and it still says unfulfilled. Did something go wrong?

Hi Jonah, nothing's gone wrong, but it's running behind. Order #1042 (the Lavender Fields diffuser) hasn't been packed yet. We normally pack within 1-2 business days, so I've flagged it with the team to go out first thing tomorrow, and you'll get tracking by email as soon as the label is made. Sorry for the wait.
My tracking for #1043 hasn't moved since yesterday and it says exception?? It's a birthday gift for Tuesday.

Hi Priya, I'm sorry about the stress. USPS logged a weather delay in Chicago yesterday (March 6), and that's the exception you're seeing. Nothing is wrong with the parcel, and weather holds usually clear within a few days, but I can't promise it will arrive by Tuesday. If it doesn't show up by Wednesday, reply here and we'll look at sending a replacement.
Update - it arrived yesterday, thanks!
So glad it made it, Priya! Tracking shows it was delivered on March 10. Hope the birthday was lovely.
One of the two cedar candles arrived with the glass cracked all the way down. Wax everywhere. Order 1044. Photo attached.

Hi Sam, I'm so sorry it arrived like that, and thank you for the photo. We'll send a replacement Cedar & Smoke 8 oz free of charge, and you don't need to return the broken one. Please wrap the glass carefully before throwing it away. I'll email the new tracking number once it ships.
Hi, I'd like to return the unscented candle from order 1045, it's unopened. How does that work?

Hi Lena, no problem. Unused items can be returned within 30 days of delivery, and your order arrived on March 16, so you're well within that. Just reply to your order confirmation email to start the return and we'll send the address. Return shipping is paid by the customer, and the $24 refund goes back to your original payment method within 5 business days of the candle reaching us.
I just ordered (1046) and realised I used my old address. Can you change it to 88 Harbor Lane, Apt 4, Portland ME 04101?

Hi Carlos, good timing - order #1046 hasn't been packed yet, so we can still update it. I've passed the new address to the team (88 Harbor Lane, Apt 4, Portland, ME 04101), and you'll get a confirmation email once it's changed.
How long does the Lavender Fields diffuser last? And do you sell refills?
Hi Hannah! The 100 ml Lavender Fields diffuser lasts about 8-10 weeks. We do sell a 200 ml refill for $22, which is enough for two full refills and comes with 8 fresh reeds.
Are your candles vegan? And what's the burn time on the 8 oz?
Hi Isla, yes, all our candles use a vegan soy-coconut wax blend with cotton wicks, and we never test on animals. The 8 oz candles burn for about 45-50 hours.
Is the big 14 oz Cedar & Smoke coming back? It's been sold out for weeks.
Hi Marcus, it is! We're pouring a new batch of the 14 oz Cedar & Smoke and expect it back in stock around April 6. The 8 oz is in stock now if you'd like something in the meantime.
The code FALL15 isn't working at checkout, can you help?
Hi Zoe, sorry about that. FALL15 was an autumn promotion and it has expired. If this is your first order with us, WELCOME10 will take 10% off.
I own a small gift shop in Asheville. Do you do wholesale, and what are the minimums?

Hi Owen, thanks for thinking of us! Yes, you can apply at shop.example.com/pages/wholesale. Opening orders have a $250 minimum and reorders $150, and wholesale pricing is 50% off retail. The first two orders are paid by card, and net-30 terms are available after that.
Do you ship to Australia?
Hi Fatima, I'm sorry, we don't ship to Australia at the moment - only within the US, to Canada and to the UK.
My order #1049 to Vancouver has been 'held for customs' since yesterday. Do I need to do something?

Hi Theo, customs holds on parcels to Canada usually clear on their own within a few business days. Canada Post will contact you if there are import duties or taxes to pay, and those are paid by the customer on delivery. If it's still held after a week, let us know and we'll chase it with the carrier.
Hey, where is order 1050? I ordered Friday.

Hi Aisha, order #1050 (the Unscented Candle) is in the packing queue and hasn't shipped yet. We pack within 1-2 business days, and Friday to Monday is still inside that window with the weekend in between. You'll get tracking by email as soon as it's labelled.
My wild fig candle is tunnelling down the middle. Did I get a bad one?

Hi Leo, it's very unlikely to be a bad candle. Tunnelling usually happens when the first burn is too short. Next time, let it burn for 2-3 hours until the melted wax reaches the edge, and trim the wick to 1/4 inch before each burn. If it still won't melt to the edge after a couple of long burns, send us a photo and we'll take a look.
Hi, just checking on 1051?
Hi Grace, order #1051 shipped on March 23 with USPS (tracking 9400100000000000001051) and is in transit to Phoenix. It should arrive within the next couple of days.
Tracking for 1052 says label created for 4 days now. Did it actually ship?

Hi Ben, sorry about the confusion. The label for #1052 was created on March 26, but USPS hasn't scanned the parcel since. I've asked our warehouse team to check whether it was handed over, and I'll update you by tomorrow. If it's lost, we'll reship your three candles right away.
Did my cancellation go through? I cancelled 1053 yesterday but haven't seen the refund.
Hi Nora, yes, order #1053 was cancelled yesterday and fully refunded. Refunds go back to your original payment method, and depending on your bank it can take up to 5 business days to show up.
I just ordered the trio as a gift for my mum (1054). Will the receipt with prices be in the box?
Hi Ravi, I can see your gift note on order #1054. Gift orders ship without prices on the packing slip, so she won't see what you paid. The note will be included too.
I have a cat - are your candles safe to burn around pets?

Hi Daniel, good question. Our fragrance oils are phthalate-free and our wax is a vegan soy-coconut blend, but cats can be sensitive to some fragrance ingredients, so we'd suggest checking with your vet. Burning in a well-ventilated room, and keeping the candle out of reach, helps too. Our Unscented Candle is a good option if you'd rather avoid fragrance altogether.
I burned the Sea Salt & Sage once and don't love the scent. Can I return it?

Hi Chloe, sorry it wasn't for you. We can only accept returns of unused, unburned candles, so unfortunately we can't take this one back. If there's a problem with how it burns, though, let us know and we'll make it right.
What does the Discovery Trio include?
Hi Henry, the Discovery Trio ($36) is three 3 oz candles, Cedar & Smoke, Wild Fig and Sea Salt & Sage, in a gift box. Each one burns for about 18 hours.
Is the pumpkin chai candle available? I can't find it on the site.
Hi Mia, Pumpkin Chai is one of our seasonal scents and it comes back each autumn. It isn't available right now. If you like warm, spicy scents, Cedar & Smoke is in stock all year.
Can I use WELCOME10 on a gift card?
Hi Felix, sorry, discount codes can't be used on gift cards. WELCOME10 does work on candles, diffusers and accessories for your first order.
Tracking for 1055 says delivered yesterday but there's nothing at my door.

Hi Emma, I'm sorry, that's frustrating. USPS marked #1055 delivered in Reno yesterday at 10:30am. Could you check with neighbours and around the building, since parcels sometimes turn up a day later? If it hasn't appeared by tomorrow, let me know and I'll open a claim with USPS and arrange a replacement.
How much is shipping and how fast is it? I need something by next Friday in Ohio.

Hi Ella, US Standard is $6.95 (free on orders of $60 or more) and takes 3-6 business days after packing. US Express is $14.95 with UPS 2nd Day Air. We pack within 1-2 business days, so if you order today, Standard should arrive in time for Friday, and Express would be the safe choice.
Do you have the brass candle snuffer in stock?
Hi Isla, the Brass Candle Snuffer is sold out at the moment, sorry. We don't have a restock date yet. The Brass Wick Trimmer ($16) is in stock if that helps.
I ordered 2 Discovery Trios (1048) but one box has 3 cedar candles instead of the mix.

Hi Olivia, I'm really sorry, that's a packing mistake on our side. Could you send a quick photo of the box? Once we have it, we'll send a correct Discovery Trio at no cost, and you're welcome to keep the extra cedar candles.
Did my express order 1047 ship?
Hi Hannah, yes! Order #1047 shipped yesterday with UPS 2nd Day Air (tracking 1ZEXAMPLE0000001047) and it's in transit now, so it should reach Sacramento tomorrow.
This is ridiculous. Order 1052 STILL hasn't moved, it's been a week. I want a refund and I'm disputing the charge with my bank.

Hi Ben, I completely understand, and I'm sorry we let this drag on. The parcel still has no USPS scan after the label was made on March 26, so we're treating it as lost. I've asked a manager to either refund the full order today or reship it by express, whichever you prefer. Just let me know, and there's no need to go through your bank.
